lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, with higher spot density and smaller diameters observed near the dorsal ridge compared to the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming a lattice where the highest luminance maxima are centered at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae (ridges) are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-value pixels on the superior edge and shadow-induced low-value pixels on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial clefts (gill slits) are clearly defined on the anterior lateral section, showing a high contrast gradient against the surrounding dark dermis.
